companyDescription.text:
Hej Customs Analyst, 

Would you like your work to make home life a little easier for people everywhere? 

Here you can be yourself at work and pass that comfort on to the customers who use what we make. We ask you to speak up, for yourself and for colleagues, so that everyone has a place at the table. Try new things, learn from what does not work, and keep going. As our Customs Analyst, you’ll get plenty of chances to take on tasks that are new to you.

jobDescription.text:
As a Customs Analyst, you’ll be a key member of the team and help us work more from facts by building data driven routines.  Most of your time will go to gathering and analysing data and turning it into reports and insight. What we do here reaches households in many countries. On a normal day, you will: 

  • Work with colleagues in several regions to align analysis, visualisation, reporting and tools (eg. VBA, SQL, Access, Excel, Power BI) and suggest where automation, data and analytics can improve 
  • Improve compliance and cut costs by analysing a wide range of business critical customs data 
  • Raise the quality and accuracy of our data and give stakeholders clear reports and dashboards

qualifications.text:
What you’ll bring with you 

To do well as our Customs Analyst we think you have: 

  • Strong skills in data analysis, collecting and cleaning data, and turning it into useful insight, plus experience with information models and data hierarchies at several levels  
  • Familiarity with business analysis methods, requirements and testing 
  • Some years in an analyst role and a feel for using technology and analysis to improve efficiency, process compliance and decisions 

It’s a bonus if you also: 

  • Know the customs and trade field and think well both tactically and operationally  
  • Speak fluent English and can explain tricky tariff classification questions simply

additionalInformation.text:
Come as you are, as a Customs Analyst, and more! 

Inter IKEA Group is the set of companies that links IKEA franchisees to product development and suppliers and sets the common IKEA direction. Each day we work to design, make and sell products and services that most people can afford. Working here, you help build a brand and a workplace that try to do right by both people and the planet. 

We care about your health, wellbeing and growth, and our benefits are built around that. As a colleague you are part of a friendly, informal and open culture, working with people in other roles, teams and countries. In this curious and hopeful setting, you’ll find many ways to develop. Build your career with us. 

We welcome your application
